open prog 20
	abs
	linear
	f(gWs_RefVel) ta(0.1) ts(0)
	frax(c, x, y)

	//Laser & wobble off ///////////////////////
	M11 P0 //Laser off
	DWELL 0
	M21 // wobble off

	//Move to start pos. And Speed ///////////////////////
	f(270)// Pos-init speed
	C(-179.936)
	f(gWs_RefVel)
	X(24.609)	Y(18.58) // start pos
	dwell 0

	//Core Laswr ///////////////////////
	M12 W200//core power

	//Ring Laswr ///////////////////////
	M14 W1100//ring power

	frax(x, y)
	f(gWs_RefVel) 

	//Wobble ///////////////////////
	M21// wobble off
	//M20 A100 B100 D100 L250 T0 // wabble setting


	M101 V40

	M140 O1 P250 // Ontime [ms], Period [um]

	M10 P100		// Laser On
